about: Motorcycle bays from council traffic orders, merged into uk-bays.json by scripts/fetch_uk_bays.py. Positions were placed from each order's description using OpenStreetMap addresses and junctions; 'approximate' marks those placed from a nearby address or postcode rather than the exact reference point. Fee is 'free'; it is marked unconfirmed unless the source's feeConfirmed is true. Capacity is left out, since councils do not record it.

hillingdon.name: Hillingdon Council traffic orders (FOI 06397)
hillingdon.confirmation: Hillingdon Council confirmed in its follow-up to FOI 06397 (November 2026) that no parking charges or permits apply to any designated on-street motorcycle parking place in the borough, and that it holds no record of how many motorcycles each place holds.

bromley.name: Bromley Council motorcycle parking page
bromley.confirmation: bromley.gov.uk/parking/motorcycle-parking (read November 2026): 'A number of free marked parking bays are available exclusively for motor scooter, moped and motorcycle riders.' Space counts are given for the town centre bays only.
